title: NPC character doesn't show in testing mode

posts.author: lemon_waffles
posts.body: Hello, I'm new here. Recently I bought RPG Maker MV. So, I was following a tutorial on youtube by SomeRanDev. I was trying to add a basic NPC that the characters could interact with, more exactly, when they go over to the character and the player presses the action button a dialogue appears. However, for some reason the NPC doesn't appear on the screen when I try to play test. I'll attach here the screenshots.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
1) have you saved the project before playtesting?
2) did you start a new playtest or did you continue from an old savefile?
3) if you open the project folder, is there a folder www inside? (there shouldn't be, if there is then that is the cause and you need to report here to learn how to repair your project)

posts.body:

yes
the www folder is for deployment only, and you must never deploy into the project folder itself.
if you do, the www folder is basically an older copy of your game (from the moment of deployment) and the playtest is redirected to that old copy.
which means that the playtest will ignore all changes to the regular project data from the main folder, always using the old copy.
and in your case the copy was from before you made that NPC event.
